notary.name: Gopal Krishan Gupta
notary.title: Notary Public
notary.bio: Gopal has been a notary public for over 41 years, serving a vast and diverse client base across London. Throughout these decades, he has provided notarial services with dedication, precision, and a personal touch that sets his practice apart.
notary.extendedBio: He is committed to helping clients with their requirements in a fast and efficient manner, understanding that time-sensitive legal matters require responsive, reliable service. His deep expertise spans all areas of notarial practice, from simple document authentication to complex international corporate transactions.
notary.personalNote: Beyond his professional life, Gopal enjoys spending time with friends and family and is a devoted cricket follower. He is also a dedicated philanthropist who constantly gives back to his community, supports students, and undertakes charitable activities in places of need.
notary.mbeDetails: Gopal was awarded an M.B.E. in the Queen's New Year's Honours 2018 for his outstanding services to British business and philanthropy — a testament to his decades of professional excellence and community contribution.
